provenance.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production terrain brush material, square opaque image, 1024x1024. Paint a seamless repeat-safe LUSH GRASSLAND surface for a premium fantasy world atlas. Aerial cartographic painterly oil/gouache miniature, broad soft meadow forms, sage and olive grassy hummocks, delicate ochre soil glimpses, low rolling organic tonal changes and restrained northwest highlights. Material must feel rich beside detailed painted mountain miniatures, while subdued beneath map labels. Full-bleed flat top-down material, not a scene, not perspective landscape; no individual trees, no mountain peaks, no coastline, no sky, no text, no border or vignette. Continuous similar detail at all edges; no prominent repeated landmarks, no photographic satellite texture, no noisy microdots. Low-to-medium frequency forms, medium-low contrast; slight physical grass/earth relief, not generic green noise. Make one coherent material only.
provenance.processing: Resize to 512x512, sRGB opaque PNG. Runtime overlap-add makes a 384px periodic sample.
